Because the entropy is measured at the jade gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the horizon audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 11 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
